text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A huge crowd gathers at the Japan Cup, Mayano Top Gun among them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian races the Emperor in her mind countless times… yet is unable to see an outcome where she defeats her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But that doesn't mean she can't do it. Her heart races in anticipation.
